title: Bachan Singh v. State of Punjab

content.caseIdentity: Bachan Singh v. State of Punjab, (1980) 2 SCC 684
content.holding: Death is the exception: rarest of rare, after weighing aggravating and mitigating circumstances. Governs sentencing under s. 103.

propositionVerification.note: Official Supreme Court judgment corroborates the citation and the Bachan Singh sentencing framework, including equal consideration of aggravating and mitigating circumstances.
